description: Single full-body native pixel-art game sprite. IDENTITY MUST MATCH: Lean adult man with narrow waist and natural shoulders, pale angular youthful face, ORANGE amber eyes and a soft knowing smile. Thick tousled dark BROWN hair side-parted, long curved curtain strands over forehead and eyes. Light warm GRAY suit jacket worn open and matching trousers, white shirt with OPEN collar, LOOSE dark brown tie, black belt. No mask or glasses. Relaxed upright SOUTH-facing stance, empty hands visible at sides, low top-down camera. Natural adult anatomy and normal torso/pelvis. Anatomical crown-to-sole height 212-224px on128x256, hair/cap excluded from body height. Soles at y248, leave unused space above shorter people, NEVER enlarge to fill canvas. Keep original individual body shape. Match style reference ONLY for crisp native1px clusters, selective dark outlines and controlled shading; own colors and clothes. Transparent background, no shadow, no text, no weapons. Entire hair and shoes inside frame.

style_image.usage_description: Use ONLY pixel rendering, outline, shading and lighting. Do not copy the reference male height, body shape, shoulder width, outfit or identity. Preserve this character own stature, build, age, hair, irises and original clothing colors and silhouette. FRONT view.
